coverage: A successful adapter write invokes the same native write then flush in one worker dispatch and returns the exact write return value. Only the following paired flush consumes its completed-flush marker; standalone/repeated flushes delegate.

Write errors propagate by object identity without flushing; flush errors propagate and do not leave a success marker. UTF-8 encoding errors preserve their original args. UTF-8, Unicode, control characters, newline framing and a greater-than-64-KiB payload produce exact expected bytes.

Real AnyIO cancellation before dispatch performs no write. Cancellation during the worker waits for the original non-abandoning write/flush to finish. A pending cancellation is observed at the paired-flush checkpoint and consumes its one-use marker.

Ordinary child stdout is certified in buffered and unbuffered modes. Unknown SDK version, replaced/wrapped/rebound FastMCP/Server methods, replaced stdio helpers, AnyIO file construction/write/flush or thread-dispatch helpers, custom stdout and non-native output buffers fall back.

The real official SDK compares initialization instructions, full list_tools output, two complete recall CallToolResult payloads and one complete large read_page CallToolResult between the optimized path and original FastMCP path. The first recall writes the ordinary result cache; the second preserves the original cache-hit response and stored cache payload.

The actual five-response SDK sequence observes five combined output worker dispatches on the optimized path versus five write and five flush dispatches on the original path. This test observer is installed only after genuine certification and delegates every operation; it is absent from product source and performance runs.

Graceful stdin EOF completes the official transport and closes the persistent MemoryBook exactly once in both paths. Standard stream closed-state behavior matches the original SDK. No explicit standard handle close was added.

Existing tests preserve actual stdio handshake, schema/read-only permissions, explicit write tool, navigation, source references, external-writer invalidation, direct/worker-thread fallbacks, lifecycle cleanup and exact token-budget MCP payloads.
limitations: Correctness tests and operation counts establish no end-to-end performance benefit or formal acceptance. No C7 development or formal timing was executed by this agent.
